message: Generated from Stimulation_2emg.hex Debug build on 2026-07-04. Normal PPG modes now stream selected LED-on raw ADC code with G/I/R tags instead of LED-ambient delta. Bias is not applied in firmware payloads; GUI code mode plots received ADC code directly and Current mode applies bias only for current conversion. RATE scheduling, active single ADC selection, 25 Hz single-color PPG timing, 8.3 Hz/ch alternating timing, 9999 TRNG, and UART DFU bootloader entry are preserved.
